# Raleigh Lead Recovery

Raleigh Lead Recovery is a missed-call recovery service for Raleigh-area plumbing shops.

The service helps plumbers catch calls that would otherwise go to voicemail. Customers keep calling the plumber's normal shop number. Busy, unanswered, or after-hours calls can forward to Dana, an intake assistant that captures the plumbing issue, callback number, address, urgency, and timing, then alerts the owner.

## Audience

- Raleigh plumbers
- Cary, Apex, Garner, Wake Forest, Durham, and Chapel Hill plumbing shops
- Small owner-operated service businesses that miss calls while the crew is on jobs

## Offer

- Free 7-day missed-call audit
- No customer-facing number change
- Owner text alerts with captured lead details
- End-of-week report showing calls answered, urgent issues, lead summaries, and estimated pipeline value

Danny Sullivan, Raleigh.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/danny-sullivan-raleigh

## Positioning

Raleigh Lead Recovery does not replace a plumbing company's phone system or dispatcher. It starts as a simple missed-call forwarding pilot. The goal is to prove whether useful calls are currently slipping to voicemail.
